Vikram Nair
vikram.nair.ml@gmail.com | +91 98xxxxxx06 | github.com/vikramnair | Kochi
SUMMARY
Data Science enthusiast focused on machine learning and data analysis. Strong in Python data libraries but has
not built web applications or worked with JavaScript.
EDUCATION
B.Tech Computer Science (AI/ML specialization), Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham (2023-2027), CGPA: 8.8/10
SKILLS
Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Matplotlib, SQL, Jupyter Notebook, basic Git
PROJECTS
Student Placement Prediction Model
•
Built a classification model using Scikit-learn to predict placement outcomes from academic data
•
Performed EDA and feature engineering using Pandas and Matplotlib
Sentiment Analysis on Twitter Data
•
Used NLTK and Scikit-learn to classify tweet sentiment; no web deployment
CERTIFICATIONS
Machine Learning by Andrew Ng (Coursera)
